affectedPublicSurfaces: THE COMPLETION ACT — the seller-visible record of what the run actually did, written on #1713's act records. It names EVERY order it shipped, EVERY order dropped at re-verify with its reason, and EVERY order the predicate excluded with its reason, each carrying a SELLER CENTER DEEP LINK. Neither a digest mechanism nor a Seller Center URL template exists anywhere in `backend/src` or `apps/*/src` today — verified: every `digest` hit in this tree is a cryptographic hash, and the only `seller_center` hits are enum literals in dashboard mock data, never a URL. So the deep-link template is NEW and its correctness is on nobody's existing test. Exceptions are NOTIFICATION-ONLY in v1 (ADR-092 d.4): no exception card, no exception write, nothing cancelled.

THE NOTIFICATION CENTRE — one in-app reminder, the ONLY wired v1 channel (§8.3 decision 4), written on #1789's notification record TWO HOURS BEFORE the window's earliest deadline if the batch is still unconfirmed. Exactly one per window: a second pass creates no second one, and a confirmed batch creates none. On expiry the next scheduled run re-proposes with urgency marked. JULI NEVER AUTO-SHIPS — the standing approval is ADR-092's deferred option 2.
THE DEADLINE LIST (#1790) gains Process Order's clocked exclusions. It is one of the seven surfaces (S-FR-1); nothing here adds an eighth.

THE STOP-REASON VOCABULARY AND ITS DB CHECK CONSTRAINT — six causes appended: `shipped_all`, `shipped_subset`, `nothing_clean`, `confirmation_expired`, `declined`, `vendor_partial_failure`. Today `services/agent/status.py`'s `StopReason` enum and `ck_workflow_runs_stop_reason` (`models/models.py:631-641`, name at `:640` — the issue body's `:630-640` is off by one) hold EXACTLY SIXTEEN values each, matching one another verbatim; `confirmation_expired` and `declined` need checking against `confirmation_expired` and `confirmation_declined` which ALREADY EXIST, so the addition may be four values, not six — resolve that against the enum rather than appending blindly and creating a near-duplicate. The addition is additive by design, and the enum, the DB CHECK, the TS union, the status-mapping totality test and the non-terminal set are all pinned places that move in ONE slice.

THE MEASURE — orders shipped before their deadline ÷ orders due, per run, computed FROM THE RUNG #1797's predicate recorded. Today `services/aggregates/thresholds.py:11` holds a global `ORDER_DISPATCH_SLA_HOURS = 48` and `compute_orders_at_sla_risk` (`computed_kpis.py:136-154`) measures against `_order_reference_time` — `payment_time or tiktok_created_at or created_at` (`:85-86`), a fallback chain, not `payment_time` alone. The new measure is a FACT, unhedged, and SEPARATE from any impact reading (S-NFR-7).

HONEST END STATES (S-FR-7). A run where NOTHING WAS CLEAN ends `completed` with its cause — NEVER `failed`. A Batch Ship call that fails outright stays on the EXISTING terminal failure path and does not acquire a new cause.

SELLER COPY. Vietnamese through the outbound guard (`services/agent/sanitize`, ADR-070, over the shared `packages/contracts/seller-copy-banned-patterns.json`); no order id, no stop-reason enum, no English string reaches the seller.

htmlRoutes: No HTML route, page, bundle or static asset changes in this slice. The completion message, notification centre and deadline list are rendered by #1808 and by W9-D's existing surfaces; here they only gain DATA. The diff is `services/agent/workflows/process_order/completion.py`, a reminder task under `workers/tasks/`, `services/agent/status.py`, `models/models.py`, a Seller Center deep-link template, `services/aggregates/`, one additive Alembic migration and tests. apps/, packages/ and ios/ are on this epic's doNotLoad list; the only permitted cross-check is that the TypeScript stop-reason union moves in the same change and `pnpm -w turbo run build` still passes.

migrationCompatibility.notes: ONE ADDITIVE, EXPAND-ONLY migration: the new stop-reason values APPENDED to `ck_workflow_runs_stop_reason` (`models/models.py:631-641`). Today the constraint and the `StopReason` enum in `services/agent/status.py` each hold exactly SIXTEEN values and agree verbatim — `confirmation_expired` and `confirmation_declined` are already among them, so check each proposed cause against the existing list and REUSE rather than append a near-twin; appending `declined` beside `confirmation_declined` would leave two spellings of one fact forever. No value is removed and no column is dropped, renamed or retyped, so old rows stay valid. THE MIGRATION NUMBER AND `down_revision` ARE RESERVED BY META and supplied with the issue. NEVER run `alembic heads`, never read the tip of `backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/versions/`, never derive the number from the newest filename — this tree already carries two same-numbered `043_*` files from exactly that mistake, and W6, W7-bis, W9 and W10-A all hold unlanded numbers off-tree. THE ASYMMETRY THAT MATTERS: widening a CHECK constraint is safe in the expand direction and UNSAFE in the contract direction — the old constraint would REJECT any row already carrying a new cause, so the downgrade is gated on those runs being closed (see rollback). `workflow_runs` is tenant-scoped and already carries RLS policies from `045_rls_policies.py`; new act and notification rows must be covered by the runtime role's existing per-table grants from `043_juli_app_role.py` (ADR-085), asserted as `juli_app`, never as the owner. Old and new code coexist: the previous release never emits a new cause and reads `stop_reason` as an opaque string.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. A Process Order run executes (#1803) but says nothing honest about it: no completion act, no deep links, no reminder, no cause and no measure. That is a bad state to ship into, so #1803 and #1805 should reach production together or not at all — a write that reports nothing is precisely the silent-failure shape ADR-090's honest end states exist to prevent. Nothing about the currently deployed system changes if this is held.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: REDEPLOY THE PREVIOUS RELEASE FIRST and restart juli-api and juli-celery-worker, then REMOVE THE REMINDER'S BEAT/ETA SCHEDULING so no further notifications are produced. The previous code runs correctly against the WIDENED constraint — a wider CHECK accepts everything it used to write — and reads `stop_reason` as an opaque string, so runs carrying a new cause are inert to it; act records and notifications written since cutover simply have no producer any more. DO NOT ROLL THE CONSTRAINT BACK IN THE SAME OPERATION. `alembic downgrade -1` narrows the CHECK and the OLD constraint WOULD REJECT every row already carrying a new cause, so the downgrade must run ONLY after all runs bearing the new causes are closed and must FAIL LOUDLY, never silently, if any such row remains — a silent narrowing here corrupts the run table rather than reverting it. Order: previous code, reminder off, constraint last and only when clear. Nothing in either direction ships or un-ships a package: this slice performs no vendor write, and a package #1803 already shipped cannot be un-shipped by any rollback — the remediation is human, and Juli never cancels.

doNotInfer: The migration number and `down_revision` are RESERVED BY META and supplied with the issue. NEVER run `alembic heads`, never read the tip of `backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/versions/`, never derive the number from the newest filename. This slice DOES carry a migration, so the reservation is binding.

Do NOT append a cause that duplicates one of the existing sixteen. `confirmation_expired` and `confirmation_declined` are ALREADY in the enum and the CHECK constraint; reuse them rather than shipping two spellings of one fact.

Do NOT move the stop-reason vocabulary in only some of its pinned places. The enum (`services/agent/status.py`), the DB CHECK (`models/models.py:631-641`), the TS union, the status-mapping totality test and the non-terminal set all move in ONE change.

Do NOT end a run `failed` because nothing was clean. 'Nothing to do' is never a failure (S-FR-7); it ends `completed` with its named cause. A Batch Ship call that fails outright stays on the EXISTING terminal failure path.
Do NOT auto-ship on expiry, and do NOT add a standing or repeat approval. On expiry the next scheduled run re-proposes with urgency marked; the standing approval is ADR-092's DEFERRED option 2.
Do NOT add a six-hour nag, a last-chance card, or push, email or Zalo transports. IN-APP IS THE ONLY WIRED CHANNEL IN v1 (§8.3 decision 4); the rest are v2 and each is its own transport slice.
Do NOT write a per-order exception card or any exception write. Exceptions are NOTIFICATION-ONLY in v1 (ADR-092 d.4): reported with a reason and a deep link, and nothing else.

Do NOT cancel anything, and do NOT add a cancel tool. An order excluded, dropped or advised-to-cancel by an error string is REPORTED, never acted on. Every cancellation is a human act on workflow 8a's surface.

Do NOT compute the measure from `ORDER_DISPATCH_SLA_HOURS = 48` or from `_order_reference_time` (`computed_kpis.py:85-86`, `payment_time or tiktok_created_at or created_at`). Read the RUNG #1797's predicate recorded; do NOT recompute a cutoff for an order that carried a deadline field, and do NOT edit the existing constant or `compute_orders_at_sla_risk` out from under its other consumers.
Do NOT hedge the measure or blend it with an impact reading. It is a fact, unhedged, and separate (S-NFR-7); a run that wrote nothing produces no impact reading.

Do NOT build a vendor-refusal branch or describe a dropped order as 'blocked by TikTok'. TikTok does NOT refuse a ship write during a pending cancellation (ADR-092 amendment 2026-09-05); Juli excluded it, and the digest must say so honestly.

Do NOT add a Create Packages or Confirm Package Shipment reference to the digest, and do NOT report FBT or Seller Own Fleet orders as actionable. FBT is monitor-only by design (`21008025`) and SOF is v2; both are LISTED with their reasons only.

Do NOT let an order id, a stop-reason enum or an English string reach the seller. Everything goes through the real outbound guard at `services/agent/sanitize` over the shared `packages/contracts/seller-copy-banned-patterns.json`.
Do NOT string-concatenate Seller Center URLs at call sites. None exists in the tree today, so build ONE template and use it everywhere; a second spelling of the link is a second thing to get wrong.
Do NOT add an eighth seller surface. The completion message, notification centre and deadline list already exist (S-FR-1); this slice gives them data.
Do NOT verify with a success-marker grep. A completion path that raises before it logs is invisible to one; assert on the act row, the notification row and the run's own stop reason.
Do NOT open the TikTok corpora catalogs (ADR-051); do NOT touch apps/** or ios/** beyond the TypeScript stop-reason union that must move in the same change — they are on this epic's doNotLoad list.
